mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 51 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, under a waning gibbous moon.
The city is preparing for winter with alternate-side parking rules beginning November 20, and don't forget the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do today, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can check out yoga at Insight Wellness on November 2 or test your knowledge at various trivia nights starting November 4.

In our weekly police report, on Sunday, October 25, officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was discovered stopped at the intersection for an extended period.
Today's featured flavor is Mint Explosion. The Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy your day.
